BrochureAbout_1.title: Grown from scratch. Hand grafted.
paragraphs: L&F Citrus Growers raises small and medium citrus trees in Mission, Texas — from rootstock to a one-gallon starter you can take home. Every tree is hand grafted the way orchard trees are grafted, for yield and a true variety.

We have specialized in citrus for more than twenty years. The facilities and the trees are TDA certified. A one-gallon tree stands about 12 to 15 inches and can set fruit in the first year if it is cared for; we still recommend pulling that first fruit so the tree can grow.
BrochureAbout_1.imageAlt: A one-gallon hand-grafted citrus tree in a nursery pot

items.title: Improved Meyer Lemon, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Improved Meyer lemon tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
The Improved Meyer lemon — Valley Lemon — is an attractive garden tree. It flowers at different times through the year, mainly in spring, and bears a medium lemon with a smooth, thin, yellow-orange rind. The fruit is moderately seedy, juicy, and acidic.

Hand grafted on Smooth Flat Seville (sour orange) rootstock at our TDA certified nursery in Mission, Texas. Protect from strong wind and from temperatures under 40°F. Sun, water, and fertilizer notes come on the label with the tree.

items.title: Thornless Mexican Lime, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Thornless Mexican lime tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
A thornless Mexican lime — Key lime — grown from scratch and hand grafted in Mission. A compact one-gallon starter for a patio or a small yard.

Same grafting method we use for orchard trees. Protect from freeze and strong wind. Pickup at the nursery; shipping only to the listed South Texas counties.

items.title: Frost Eureka Lemon, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Frost Eureka lemon tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
Frost Eureka is the classic acid lemon we graft for home growers. A small tree, raised here, ready for a pot or the ground in a protected spot.

Hand grafted at our TDA certified facilities. Keep it above 40°F and out of hard wind while it is young.

items.title: N-33 Navel Orange, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: N-33 navel orange tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
N-33 navel on a one-gallon starter. Grown and grafted in the Valley for a true navel at a size you can carry home.

Every tree leaves with a care label. We recommend dropping first-year fruit so the tree can put on wood.

items.title: Persian Lime, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Persian lime tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
Persian lime, hand grafted and grown from scratch in Mission. A seedless-style lime tree in a one-gallon pot — small enough for a patio, grafted for orchard yield.

Available for pickup at the nursery. Shipping only inside the listed Texas counties.

items.title: Pink Variegated Eureka, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Pink variegated Eureka lemon tree with mottled leaves
items.description:
Variegated Pink Eureka — an ornamental lemon with mottled leaves and pink-fleshed fruit. Grown here as a small tree, not a grocery plant.

Hand grafted at our TDA certified nursery. Keep young trees out of freeze and hard wind.

items.title: Rio Red Grapefruit, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Rio Red grapefruit tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
Rio Red grapefruit on a one-gallon starter, grafted in the Valley where this variety belongs. A small tree now; the same grafting used in commercial groves.

Pickup in Mission. We ship only to Webb, Hidalgo, Cameron, Willacy, Brooks, Starr, Kenedy, Jim Hogg, Kleberg, and Nueces Counties.

items.title: Olinda Valencia Orange, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Olinda Valencia orange tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
Olinda Valencia — a juice orange on a compact starter. Grown and hand grafted in Mission so the variety stays true.

One-gallon trees are 12 to 15 inches tall. Care instructions travel with the tree.

items.title: Clementine Mandarin, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Clementine mandarin tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
Clementine mandarin, raised as a small tree from our benches. Easy to handle now; grafted for fruit later.

Hand grafted in our TDA certified facilities in Mission, Texas.

items.title: Calamondin, 1 gal
items.imageAlt: Calamondin tree in a one-gallon pot
items.description:
Calamondin — a small, sour-sweet citrus that stays a manageable tree. Grown from scratch here like the rest of the bench.

A good patio tree. Pickup at 5320 N Minnesota Rd, Mission.

BrochureAbout_2.title: Thirty varieties. One gallon at a time.
paragraphs: Lemons, limes, navels, Valencias, grapefruit, kumquats, satsumas, mandarins, tangelos, and a short list of exotics — finger lime, kaffir, Buddha’s Hand, yuzu, limequat. Over thirty varieties are grown at the nursery.
Trees ship only to Webb, Hidalgo, Cameron, Willacy, Brooks, Starr, Kenedy, Jim Hogg, Kleberg, and Nueces Counties. Orders from anywhere else are canceled. Most one-gallon trees are pickup in Mission.
